title: Wave Equation
text: The fundamental wave equation relates speed (v), frequency (f), and wavelength: v = f times wavelength. This applies to all types of waves.

title: Final Calculation
text: Substitute the values: v = 660 Hz times 0.433 m = 285.78 m/s. This is approximately 286 m/s. The wave speed on a string depends on the tension and mass per unit length of the string.
